newsitem.title: ITALY: Blair and his boys to take on Italians at soccer.
newsitem.headline: Blair and his boys to take on Italians at soccer.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair and his soccer-mad sons are planning to take on the Italians at their national game during a break in their poolside holiday in Tuscany, a British embassy spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

Blair, his sons Euan, 13, and Nicky, 11, and other members of his entourage will line up against Italian police and security men for a five-a-side friendly in the picturesque town of San Gimignano on Wednesday, she said.
"They (the Blairs) are very keen on football and they often play," she said. British officials declined to give other details and wanted the match strictly off-limits for the media.

Blair, accompanied by his wife Cherie and nine-year-old daughter Kathryn, arrived in Italy 10 days ago for two weeks of relaxation at a villa in the rolling Tuscan hills -- dubbed by the British press "Chiantishire" after the region's famous red wine and big English expatriate community.
